title: US data brokers are selling half a billion dollars in RL training environments to Chinese AI labs
summary: American data brokers sell so-called RL environments to Chinese AI labs, helping them save compute during model development. A ChinaTalk investigation identifies at least nine companies involved. American data firms like Mercor, Surge AI, AfterQuery, and Turing are selling roughly half a billion dollars' worth of training data to Chinese AI labs, according to an investigation by ChinaTalk .
